quotes.text: // Non-zero bucket count indirectly proves the part URL is readable.

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The new forwarding task checks body text, one attachment, report.pdf and positive size. It never opens or compares the attachment payload. Its comment claiming bucket count proves part-URL readability therefore exceeds the direct assertions. Review records a failed content-test attempt and declined extra message/* coverage, not proof that those cases work. All four assertion messages state expected behavior. No test or part-URL read ran; required primary comment5 remains unavailable.
title: The malformed-alternative forwarding test checks metadata rather than payload readability
